positions.name: WeeklyRollupVsRunBundle
positions.frame: What does each recurring update artifact answer for, and does a weekly roll-up replace the per-run bundle or sit beside it so the week's reactions reach people without scrolling back?
positions.why: All five segments turn on one question: how weekly reactions reach people when a per-run bundle already exists. src-1 frames the ruling and src-3 records the question it answered. src-2 states the ruling, which keeps the per-run bundle and adds a Friday roll-up. src-4 gives the reason the two are not substitutes: the bundle serves the run and the roll-up serves the week. src-5 rejects a daily digest because it would repeat the bundle. src-4 is reported through the memo author with split footing, and src-1 reports the ruling in the memo's own voice. The set holds a settled directive (src-2) alongside a reasoned argument (src-4) without resolving the tension between them.
